Name: Corner Footprint TRE
Description: The Corner Footprint TRE (CSCRNA) provides the geodetic latitude, longitude, and ground elevation at the four corners of the sensor (sub-image) footprint (or MBR, if the footprint is of irregular shape).  If the data for a given sensor (sub-image) spans multiple image segments, the CSCRNA TRE shall be identical in each of the image segments and shall represent the extent of the entire sub-image.

PREDICT_CORNERS.Name: Predicted Corners Flag
PREDICT_CORNERS.Description: This indicates whether the corner coordinates are predicted or are based on actual measurements. (Y = Predicted, N = Actual).

ULCNR_LAT.Name: Image Corner Latitude Upper Left Corner of Image
ULCNR_LAT.Description: This is the latitude of the upper left corner of the image.  Corner line and sample pair (i.e. corner pixel) is projected from the image plane to the reference ellipsoid (i.e. WGS-84) along the corner pixel's Earth Centered Earth Fixed (ECEF) vector and then converted to Geodetic latitude.

ULCNR_LONG.Name: Image Corner Longitude Upper Left Corner of Image
ULCNR_LONG.Description: This is the longitude of the upper left corner of the image.  Corner line and sample pair (i.e. corner pixel) is projected from the image plane to the reference ellipsoid (i.e. WGS-84) along the corner pixel's ECEF vector and then converted to Geodetic longitude.

ULCNR_HT.Name: Image Corner Height at Upper Left Corner of Image
ULCNR_HT.Description: The height of the upper left corner of the image, referenced to the reference ellipsoid (i.e. WGS-84).
